title: Q-BLIND-name-clearance: close the ip blind spot name-clearance
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every blindspots scan
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation blindspots --closed name-clearance
**Prediction:** blindspots_open <= 7 within 168 h
**Status:** open

Why the owner would not know to ask: Another party may hold a trademark on the name; discovering that after launch forces a costly rename.
Action: search public trademark registers and record the result with sources. The probe in doctrine/blindspots.json passes when it is done.
